notes.albums: Four albums: fan version (10), kids set (2), hoodie (2), player version (6). Three of them share the minute 20:14, so the order was checked by eye after the Newcastle reordering - the two photographs carrying shorts are p132 and p133, exactly where the kids album sits, and the two hoodies and six mannequin shots follow in the order the chat gives. This block is correct as harvested.
notes.dedupe: Two Juventus products were live and the hash matched neither. p124 matched by eye: it is the live 2025/26 home, the striped shirt with the PINK shoulder trim. The 1997/98 Sony retro is not in this batch. p137 is the player cut of the 2024/25 striped home and went in as new.
notes.sponsorDating: Jeep from 2012; the sponsor gained the VISIT DETROIT line in 2024/25, which separates the otherwise identical striped home shirts here: p126 carries plain gold Jeep (2023/24), p131 and p137 carry Jeep Visit Detroit (2024/25).
notes.noSponsorShirts: p123 and p125 are the hooped shirt WITHOUT a sponsor - the supplier sells a blank version alongside the sponsored one. They are titled by colour rather than season so they do not collide with the 2026/27 home.
